title: RAW_UNSCREENED: chey als Konditionalsignal oder Demonstrativform
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f77r.37 has teeolain chey qoteedy qokain cheedy cheey lchedy; f29v.2 has chey before another body.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed source lines and cached report outputs; no new selectors, images or reserves.
design.mechanism: Conditional reading introduces a subordinate condition; demonstrative reading points to a written item.
design.unit: Exact whole-form occurrences at the named loci.
design.prediction: Condition predicts a consequent with a written predicate; demonstrative predicts a host and no mandatory clause boundary.
concrete_observations: GDT936 reports chey at f77r.37 before qoteedy/qokain and at f29v.2 after cthy.
linked_consequences: Condition needs a consequent across the local span; demonstrative needs a host in each occurrence.
design.distinguishing_observation: Use fixed clause-boundary candidates and written hosts at both loci, without fluent sentence insertion.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The two lines have insufficient independent syntax to distinguish condition from demonstrative.
